coverage.denominator_policy: Nine grouped route families from the current production-surface contract; browser, Penpot and strict A=S=P credit remain separate.
coverage.browser_review_fraction: 0/9 until V0 publishes the exact preview verdict
coverage.penpot_linked_fraction: 0/9 until R0.PENPOT materializes and read-back verifies linked instances

immutable_behavior_boundaries.rollback_rule: Never roll back the restoration while retaining a test that treats the behavior as obsolete. A product decision is required to retire or replace it.

must_preserve: DateListingSurface and WeekendListingSurface remain distinct compositions
immutable_behavior_boundaries.rollback_rule: Reject any rollback or conflict resolution that aliases Weekend into the date route solely to reduce root count.
A visual normalization rollback may restore prior CSS/markup but may not remove or rename runtime hooks without a separately reviewed product/runtime change.
Rollback a consumer migration independently from the M0 MediaFrame/EventMediaRail root; never revert the canonical M0 root merely to restore one consumer.

rollback_units.atomicity: catalog delegation and its regression contracts
rollback_units.rollback_trigger: build/test failure or V0 regression attributable to catalog delegation

rollback_units.atomicity: foundation binding plus preserved local personalization behavior
focus visual bindings and source diagnostics; runtime hooks preserved
artifact family identity, states and canonical close/action bindings
rollback_units.rollback_trigger: collection state or find/dialog behavior regression

rollback_units.atomicity: partner registry and information route composition
rollback_units.rollback_trigger: missing projected partner or layout/accessibility regression

rollback_units.atomicity: route identity and canonical action-icon substitution only
rollback_units.rollback_trigger: festival ordering, save/source behavior, category mapping or layout regression

rollback_units.atomicity: foundation alias application without changing interaction/runtime code

atomic_subunits: RB-A0-EVENT-RAILS: replace hero-selector and poster-strip markup with EventMediaRail while retaining hooks
RB-A0-EVENT-LAYOUT-CSS: remove only orphan duplicate EventCard/media ownership
RB-A0-MOBILE-RAIL-CSS: remove only duplicate object-fit/object-position declarations now owned by MediaFrame

rollback_units.atomicity: route-local hero/deck paint ownership only after classification
rollback_units.rollback_trigger: club directory identity or card navigation regression

integration_order: Resolve current candidate, F0, M0 and A0 heads.
Integrate accepted F0/M0 roots before applying A0 consumer mechanics.
Apply each READY_FOR_R0_MECHANICAL subunit as its own commit and run its exact focused tests.
Integrate source-converged A0 units without squashing away rollback boundaries.
Run the one canonical Kaggle full Review Preview.
Trigger V0 with the exact HTTP-200 URL and matching identity.
Materialize Penpot only from accepted source bindings and V0 evidence.

rollback_execution.default: revert the smallest failing rollback unit or mechanical subunit
forbidden: revert the complete A0 branch for one route defect
revert canonical F0/M0 roots to accommodate an unmigrated consumer
silently drop accepted user-facing behavior during conflict resolution
promote a source-only rollback as browser-verified
